question: Why is this principle regarded as supreme above all other realities?
premises: This principle establishes all beginnings and ends.
Its supremacy follows from that universal establishment.
inference: This is supreme because it establishes all beginnings and ends.
uncertainties: The exact referent of etat may be the seat, mantra, or experiential ground.
plain_english: Because it establishes all beginnings and ends, this is supreme above all.
